lines.text: A broker is selling cut stone off a grave. The cell has been following him for months.
You sold the stone on. I have the receipt. I am not going to say anything. I just have it.
You named the Helix broker. That went into the file. Twice.
Those Dominion seals on the cisterns. They are cataloguing wells. Wells are routes.
The wells stand because the Keths decided. The cell approves of the Keths.
